test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To have the heart of stone

options.text: Not being able to make a decision

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'To feel no pity'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"To have the heart of stone"** (पत्थर का दिल होना) implies lacking compassion or being unfeeling.
